objective: Close the smallest remaining cloud-to-local orchestration gap for the live 14-day OKX BTC-USDT microstructure diagnostic. Add one read-only, deterministic monitor for the dedicated Server Canonical intake state; expose its bounded progress through get_research_status; and let the existing single daily heartbeat enqueue exactly one hash-backed Coach event when discovery analysis becomes due or integrity is blocked. The performance thesis is operational rather than alpha: remove manual discovery and reduce evidence-to-diagnostic dispatch delay to the next existing cloud cycle while preserving MISSING_PROOF for predictive value, PnL, drawdown, fees, slippage, and strategy usefulness.

inputs.locator: 2026-08-06T13:30Z; worker release 20260806T132639Z; microstructure state WAITING_FOR_DAY; start 2026-08-08; accepted 0/14; source active but static and not enabled; queue IDLE; canonical research WAITING_FOR_EVIDENCE; exactly one Codex Cloud Ops schedule; get_research_status currently omits microstructure progress

stop_conditions: Change exactly six files and no others: add research_pipeline/microstructure_monitor.py; edit research_pipeline/heartbeat.py, research_pipeline/tests/test_evidence.py, research_mcp/queue.py, research_mcp/tests/test_queue.py, and docs/server-research-worker-v2.md. Preserve this Manager-created task file and every unrelated path.

The monitor is read-only and bounded to state_root/microstructure. It must reject symlinks, non-regular state files, ambiguous multiple JSON states, noncanonical bytes, invalid contract state, and present lock/temp recovery markers fail closed. It must never read the evidence drop, binding secrets, network, processes, systemd, Trading runtime, DB, orders, or funds.

Expose a compact microstructure_diagnostic object with status, diagnostic_id, start_day, accepted_day_count, required_day_count, next_expected_day, artifact_path, SHA-256, and a date-derived lag classification. No configured directory is NOT_CONFIGURED; a configured empty or corrupt namespace is RECOVERY_BLOCKED rather than silently idle.

For a valid WAITING_FOR_DAY state classify pre-start/current-day normally and classify next_expected_day earlier than the current UTC day as CAPTURE_OVERDUE. DIAGNOSTIC_READY remains discovery-analysis-only. INTEGRITY_BLOCKED, recovery failure, and overdue capture are integrity conditions; no retry, repair, backfill, source restart, or lifecycle write is permitted.

Integrate through the existing run_heartbeat_cycle only. A changed DIAGNOSTIC_READY fingerprint emits exactly one EVIDENCE_REVIEW_DUE event with next_action DISPATCH_VALIDATED_LOCAL_MICROSTRUCTURE_DIAGNOSTIC_TASK. A changed INTEGRITY_BLOCKED or CAPTURE_OVERDUE fingerprint emits exactly one INTEGRITY_ALERT. Repeated unchanged heartbeats must not duplicate events, while the existing durable Coach outbox retains unacknowledged events.

Every emitted event must reference an existing canonical artifact path inside the ResearchStore and its exact SHA-256. If a recovery fault has no safely hashable microstructure artifact, fail the heartbeat through the existing failure-record path rather than inventing evidence or following a symlink.

Keep the primary candle research_status and 90-day trigger unchanged. Add the monitor summary as a separate field in heartbeat results and get_research_status. Never merge microstructure days into candle observations, register a candidate, select a hypothesis, open OOS, claim alpha/PnL/DD value, or update the V6 schedule contract.

Tests must cover not configured, pre-start, capturing, progress, overdue, ready, intake-integrity-blocked, recovery-blocked, exact artifact hash, get_research_status exposure, one-time event dedupe, durable outbox retention, and strict separation from the candle status. Keep tests temporary and offline.

Run only exact task validation, python -m unittest research_pipeline.tests.test_evidence research_mcp.tests.test_queue, focused monitor checks within those modules, and git diff --check for the six authorized files. Do not run PackageOnly, Maven, SSH, server, systemd, network, source, cleanup, evidence capture, or deployment.

Return exactly one JSON object conforming to local-research-result.schema.json with exact task_sha256, exactly six files_changed/artifacts, concrete PASS/MISSING_PROOF checks, and all safety assertions false. Manager review, commit, PackageOnly, deployment, live status readback, and source continuity verification remain separate actions.
